title: To Serve and to Give
description: Who is this, and what does it cost to follow him?
This week we open Mark 10:32–45 and ask what the passage is really saying, before we ask what it means for us.
We notice how the passage fits into the larger story of The Servant King, and what has come just before it.
Along the way we meet some familiar excuses, and some better reasons to hope.
